title: SQL Server connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One SQL Server instance's settings, read by the native SQL Server family (`loams_connector_sqlserver::SqlServerFactory`, CN2 Task 12) on tiberius 0.13.0. The keys are the guide's table (docs/guides/connectors/sql-server.md). `password`, `entra.client_secret` and `token` hold secret **names** (D189), exactly the manifest's `secrets`. Naming `table` makes the instance a sink.

auth.description: `sql`: a SQL login (`user`, `password`). `entra`: an Entra ID service principal (`entra.*`). `entra-token`: an access token the runtime keeps fresh (`token`).

password.description: The SQL login's password (`auth: sql`). The **name** of a secret in the namespace's store (D189), resolved when the connector connects; never the value.

entra.description: An Entra ID service principal (`auth: entra`): a token for https://database.windows.net/.default with the client-credentials grant.

client_secret.description: The client secret. The **name** of a secret in the namespace's store (D189), resolved when the connector connects; never the value.

authority.description: The authority, for a sovereign cloud.

token.description: An Entra ID access token the runtime keeps fresh, resolved again at each connection (`auth: entra-token`). The **name** of a secret in the namespace's store (D189), resolved when the connector connects; never the value.

encrypt.description: `strict`: TDS 8.0, TLS before the first TDS byte (SQL Server 2022, Azure SQL). `disable`: no TLS, a private network only, and refused with Entra ID.

ca_pem.description: Extra trusted roots, as PEM (not a secret).

trust_server_certificate.description: Accept any server certificate: a self-signed test server only.

host_name_in_certificate.description: The name the server certificate carries, when not `host`.

mode.description: Sources: `batch` reads tables in key order under one snapshot (`rows`, Arrow); `cdc` follows the CDC change tables (`change`, `schema-change`).

tables.description: Sources: the tables to read, `schema.table` (`dbo` when unqualified).

key.description: Batch reads: the columns to page by. Sink: the upsert key, MERGE … ON (key). Defaults to the table's primary key. Declared because the manifest declares capabilities.sink.upsert: true.

partitions.description: Batch reads: split a table whose key is one integer column into this many key ranges.

cursor_column.description: Batch reads: read incrementally by this column, then the key (one split per table).

poll_interval_ms.description: Batch reads with `cursor_column`: start again this long after reaching the end. CDC: the interval between polls of the change tables (1000 by default).

snapshot.description: CDC: `initial` reads the table at the start LSN first; `never` starts at the current maximum LSN.

metrics_interval_ms.description: CDC: how often the lag and position-risk metrics are sampled.

retention_minutes.description: CDC: the cleanup job's retention, for the position-risk metric, when msdb.dbo.cdc_jobs is not readable.

table.description: Sinks: the target table, `schema.table`. Naming it makes the instance a sink.

schema_name.description: Sinks: the schema of an unqualified `table`.

transactional.description: Sinks: exactly once, each batch and its checkpoint in one transaction fenced by the lease epoch; `false` is at least once and idempotent by key.

evolution.description: The schema evolution policy (see the schema-mapping guide).

lossy.description: Conversions allowed to lose information, by path (for example a `datetime2` column read as UTC).
